title: fresh-3-repo-real-world-tests
workingTreeNote: Clean working tree before recording the structured real-world result; this record persists the sweep artifact and result entry.

dependencyPrep.notes: FastAPI clone had uv.lock but no config $schema references or local schema paths requiring installed dependencies for DollarLint validation, so dependency prep was unnecessary.
pnpm clone had a large workspace and lockfiles, but the only explicit config $schema found was a remote Changesets schema; installing the monorepo was not needed for schema resolution fidelity.
GitHub CLI clone had go.mod/go.sum and no config $schema references or local schema paths requiring module downloads for DollarLint validation.

repositories.name: fastapi
repositories.notes: Python web framework with pyproject, CI, and packaging configs.

repositories.name: pnpm
repositories.notes: Package manager monorepo with workspace and toolchain configs.

repositories.name: cli
repositories.notes: GitHub CLI with Go module, CI, release, and tooling configs.

findings: DollarLint built successfully with go build -o bin/dollarlint ./cmd/dollarlint, then validated the prepared 3-repo corpus.
Corpus summary: discovered 1395 files, validated 1121, skipped 269, failed 5 parse cases, reported 50 issues, and emitted 0 warnings.

Repository results: cli had 93 discovered files, 17 validated, 76 skipped, and 0 issues; fastapi had 52 discovered, 39 validated, 13 skipped, and 15 validation issues; pnpm had 1249 discovered, 1065 validated, 179 skipped, 5 parse failures, and 35 total issues.

FastAPI signal: 11 localized docs/*/mkdocs.yml files contain only INHERIT: ../en/mkdocs.yml and are flagged by the MkDocs schema for missing site_name when validated before inherited config is merged.

pnpm signal: two package.json5 fixtures under workspace/project-manifest-reader/__fixtures__/commented-package-json5 look like intentionally valid JSON5 with comments and trailing block comments, but DollarLint reports unexpected EOF.

Fixture noise: most pnpm validation issues are intentional fixtures under __fixtures__, test fixtures, or committed node_modules fixture data; these are useful parser/schema stress cases but weak evidence of user-facing config failures.

productRecommendations.recommendation: Investigate JSON5 parser compatibility for valid commented package.json5 files with trailing block comments and no final newline.
productRecommendations.rationale: pnpm's commented-package-json5/package.json5 and modified.json5 are fixtures that appear intentionally valid, but both failed with unexpected EOF; that points to a parser edge case DollarLint can likely improve.

productRecommendations.recommendation: Consider MkDocs INHERIT-aware validation or clearer diagnostics for inherited MkDocs configs.
productRecommendations.rationale: FastAPI has 11 localized mkdocs.yml files containing only INHERIT: ../en/mkdocs.yml; schema validation reports missing site_name before inheritance is resolved, which may be noisy for MkDocs users.

productRecommendations.recommendation: Consider stronger fixture/noise classification in real-world triage for __fixtures__, test/fixtures, and committed node_modules fixture trees.
productRecommendations.rationale: The pnpm sweep produced many intentional fixture-data findings, including invalid workspace manifests and package metadata inside fixture node_modules trees; better classification would keep real product signal easier to see.

productDecisions: No product code changes were made during this sweep; this run only records validation evidence and follow-up recommendations.
Dependency preparation was intentionally skipped for all three repositories because inspection found no local schema paths or dependency-installed schemas needed for validation fidelity.
Classified cli as clean for this run, fastapi as mostly schema-context/noise around inherited or versioned config semantics, and pnpm as mostly fixture noise plus one parser-compatibility follow-up.
followUp: Open a focused issue or implementation task for the JSON5 unexpected EOF edge case, using the two pnpm commented-package-json5 fixtures as reproduction material.
If MkDocs support becomes a priority, prototype validation that resolves INHERIT before applying the MkDocs schema or emits an inheritance-specific note instead of a plain missing-site_name error.
Continue the next real-world sweep with fresh repositories rather than retesting this corpus by default.
